title: VSI 400 Gallon Jet Agitated Hydroceder Features Overview
reason: The video describes the features and capabilities of the VSI 400 gallon jet agitated hydroceder, which is a real-world product and machine.

tasks.task: Describe the structural features of the VSI 400 gallon jet agitated hydroceder.

subtasks.text: Observe the fully welded structural skid frame with fork pockets for easy loading and unloading.
Note the four built-in tie-down points for strapping the hydroceder down.

tasks.task: Explain the protective coating and engine setup of the VSI 400 gallon jet agitated hydroceder.

subtasks.text: Examine the bead blasting, epoxy priming, and powder coating process for the skid frame.
Highlight the use of a proven Honda GX390 engine with standard electric start.

tasks.task: Describe the agitation and pumping system of the VSI 400 gallon jet agitated hydroceder.

subtasks.text: Observe the dual agitation system capable of mixing from the top and the side.
Highlight the high performance, three-inch poly pump for thick slurry mixing.

tasks.task: Describe the plumbing and attachment options of the VSI 400 gallon jet agitated hydroceder.

subtasks.text: Note the banjo flanged poly parts with stainless steel clamps for plumbing.
Highlight the ease of disassembly for maintenance.

tasks.task: Describe the filling options and pond suction feature of the VSI 400 gallon jet agitated hydroceder.

subtasks.text: Observe the multiple filling methods including garden hose, pond suction, and hydrant.
Note the standard pond suction feature for regular pond water use with a two-inch cam lock hose kit.
